eps.t: All for the Love of Meloetta!
eps.ov: An unexpected encounter with an old friend in Virbank City presents our heroes with unexpected challenges galore!

eps.t: Piplup, Pansage, and a Meeting of the Times!
eps.ov: With Cynthia's help, our heroes have begun training for the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup, and a couple of old friends come along for the wild ride!
When our heroes take a break from special training, a mysterious island offers much more than they bargained for!

eps.t: The Mystery of the Missing Cubchoo!
eps.ov: As our heroes train for the upcoming Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup, a worried neighbor of Cynthia's comes by for help!
While our heroes continue preparations for the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup, a sudden emergency and a Pokémon in need change their lives forever!
The Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup is off to a roaring start, while our heroes are faced with rivals old and new!
The second round of the Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup is off and running, while a battle between the winner and Alder waits in the wings!

eps.t: Ash, Iris, and Trip: Then There Were Three! (3)
eps.ov: The exciting Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup continues, and the semi-finals and finals hang in the balance of the results of these last two matches!
The Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup may be winding down, but new adventures are just beginning!
Our heroes' new friend Cameron needs to win his eighth Gym badge in order to enter the Unova League, and that sets the stage for an unforgettable adventure!
While Ash trains for entry into the Unova League, our heroes discover a Pokémon nursery that urgently needs their help!
A sinister plot to take over the Unova region is taking shape, and our heroes are caught in the middle of it!
Team Rocket's "Operation Tempest" is under way with a fierce vengeance, and the fate of the Unova region hangs in the balance!

eps.t: Beauties Battling for Pride and Prestige!
eps.ov: On their way to the site of the upcoming Unova League, our heroes take on an unexpectedly messy battle challenge!

eps.t: A Surface to Air Tag Battle Team!
eps.ov: As our heroes continue their trek to Vertress City and the Unova League, they're challenged to a Tag Battle the likes of which they've never experienced!
Our heroes are visiting the Village of Dragons on their way to Vertress City, where Iris is confronted with several life-changing challenges!

eps.t: Drayden Versus Iris: Past, Present, and Future!
eps.ov: As Iris takes on her battle challenge issued by the Opelucid City Gym Leader Drayden, little does she know what's truly in store!

eps.t: Team Eevee and the Pokémon Rescue Squad!
eps.ov: Traveling to Vertress City and the Unova League, our heroes are introduced to a brave family on a mission of service!
The Unova League is off and running, old friends and rivals are reuniting, and the battle action is unrelenting!
As the battle excitement in Vertress City builds to a fever pitch, the Unova League pairs friends and rivals, old and new!
While the Unova League prepares to move to the third round, our heroes are faced with a case of lost and found!
As the Unova League makes its way through the third round and barrels toward the quarterfinals, strategy and friendship lead the way!
It's the fourth round of the Unova League, and Cameron's "secret weapon" turns out to be more than anyone thought, including Cameron!
As the Unova League roars toward the final match, the competition becomes more fierce, and the strength and skill levels more amazing!
